verdictReason: Every hard gate has measured evidence at 81376baeda1b5453c1fcfe6fc0a09ccec3f892c8, and the two gates that decide publication were re-run by the coordinator against the published bytes rather than accepted from the porting session. The earlier run 32303203988 remains recorded as a failure and is not converted into a pass, and the successor head is not accepted because its runs had not completed.

arm64Purity.detail: 34 of 34 shipped images ARM64 or ARM64X in the re-expanded published ZIP

buildGreen.detail: Debug and Release built on windows-11-arm with every cl and link invocation from HostArm64 toolset 14.44.35207

runtimeValidated.detail: The published asset was downloaded, checksum-verified, expanded and executed on native ARM64 by a coordinator-authored workflow that does not build the product

planCompleteness.detail: Every task maps to findings and every finding of blocker or high severity is addressed by a task. The analysis and plan were reconstructed after the migration, which is disclosed in plan.json rather than concealed.

projectGraphComplete.detail: The ARM64 project graph is validated and TestCppCli is explicitly excluded rather than remapped, because MSVC has no /clr for ARM64

scenarioValidated.detail: Coverage is collected on native ARM64 from the build output and again from the expanded package, with the unreachable line correctly reported as not executed

testFailurePropagation.detail: Fail-closed accounting is asserted in every job after run 32303203988 reported success over a failed ARM64 build

foreignArchRefusal.detail: A green run on ARM64 hardware cannot distinguish a native package from an emulated x64 one, so the pass is paired with a refusal. The same OpenCppCoverage.exe from the published asset was executed on three runners: windows-11-arm returned CoverageExitCode=0 with ProcessArchitecture=Arm64, while windows-2022 and windows-latest both refused to start it with Started=False and NativeErrorCode=216 (ERROR_EXE_MACHINE_TYPE_MISMATCH). Run 32396073242, all three jobs green. The first attempt (32395676572) is retained as a failure: it asserted NativeErrorCode=193 only, and current Windows returns 216, so the gate failed a package that was behaving exactly as designed.

hostToolchainSingle.detail: cl and link command lines parsed from the retained build log of run 32357865925 job 96390868682 at 81376ba: Debug 32 cl and 16 link, Release 31 cl and 16 link, every invocation from HostArm64\arm64 at toolset 14.44.35207, zero HostX86. MSBuild resolved as Bin\arm64\MSBuild.exe 17.14.51.32402 with VCToolArchitecture=NativeARM64. The predecessor ec2cce74 passed its own preflight while compiling entirely from HostX86\arm64, so this gate asserts the invoked command lines rather than the compiler that resolves.

packaging.detail: Redistributables filtered by PE machine with the rejection recorded, the required Plugins\Exporter directory present, and the archive re-expanded and rescanned before publication

performance.detail: No performance comparison between architectures was requested or measured, and none is claimed.
